_linkWithPhoneNumber_help: Optional. Put the WhatsApp number here (e.g. "+44 7700 900123") to link with an 8-character pairing code instead of scanning a QR code.
_homebaseChat_help: Name of the WhatsApp chat (or group) where the bot sends anything that needs you. You control the bot from there too.
_mode_help: auto = replies to everyone automatically; off = paused, messages are just sent to your homebase
_excludeList_help: People the bot never replies to. Their messages go to your homebase. Use names as saved in your phone or numbers, e.g. ["Mum", "+44 7700 900123"]
_blockList_help: People the bot ignores completely (no reply, no alert).
holdFor: money, payments, prices or anything to do with your business
making, changing or cancelling plans, meetings or times
agreeing to anything or making promises
_reportReplies_help: true = also tell you in homebase every time the bot replies to someone
_youTakeOverMinutes_help: When you reply to someone yourself, the bot stays out of that chat for this long
_quietHours_help: When on, nobody gets an auto-reply during these hours; messages just go to homebase.
